title: Search Params Validated by Zod
prompt:
Use a Zod schema to validate `?page=&q=` search params; consume them via `useSearch` with full type inference. **Requirements:** 1. In `router.tsx`, import TanStack Router primitives + `useSearch`, plus `z` from `zod`. 2. Define `const SearchSchema = z.object({ page: z.number().int().min(1).default(1), q: z.string().default('') });`. 3. Define `searchRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, path: '/search', validateSearch: (raw) => SearchSchema.parse(raw), component: SearchView })`. 4. Inside `SearchView`, call `const { page, q } = useSearch({ from: searchRoute.id })` and render `

page: {page}

q: {q}

`. 5. Export `App` + `makeRouter`.
hints: `validateSearch` is the parser/coercer -- raw query strings come in, typed values go out.
Pair `validateSearch` with `useSearch({ from: route.id })` so the consumer is fully typed.
Defaults inside the schema fill in values when the URL omits them.
